require 'json';require 'digest';require 'fileutils';require 'open3'
o=File.expand_path(__dir__);out=o+'/report.json';raise 'Output exists' if File.exist?(out)
prior=File.expand_path('../capture-membership-2026-10-30',o);bin=prior+'/candidate-kujo';probe=prior+'/task-allocation-probe';sha=->(p){Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest}
r={status:'running',pid:Process.pid,identities:[bin,probe,__FILE__].to_h{|p|[p,sha.call(p)]},sources:{},rows:[],semantics:[]};save=->{File.write(out,JSON.pretty_generate(r)+"\n")};save.call
begin
 %w[scalar-first collection-first scalar-only].product([64,2048],%w[once fresh],[1,2,16,32]).each do |shape,width,snapshot,calls|
  d=o+'/fixtures/'+[shape,width,snapshot,calls].join('-');FileUtils.mkdir_p(d)
  writes=case shape
   when 'scalar-first'; 'state[0] = amount state[1] = [amount] state[2] = {"value": amount}'
   when 'collection-first'; 'state[1] = [amount] state[2] = {"value": amount} state[0] = amount'
   else; 'state[0] = amount state[1] = amount state[2] = amount'
  end
  owner="mut state := [] mut k := 0 while k < #{width} { state = push(state, 0) k += 1 }\nexport func snapshot() { return state }\nexport func edit(amount) { #{writes} return amount }\n"
  check=->(name,value){"assert_equal(#{name}[0], #{value}) assert_equal(#{name}[1]#{shape=='scalar-only' ? '' : '[0]'}, #{value}) assert_equal(#{name}[2]#{shape=='scalar-only' ? '' : '["value"]'}, #{value})"}
  source="from owner import snapshot, edit\nlet original := snapshot()\nmut i := 0 while i < #{calls} { #{snapshot=='fresh' ? 'let saved := snapshot()' : ''} assert_equal(edit(i + 1), i + 1) #{snapshot=='fresh' ? 'if i == 0 { assert_equal(saved[0], 0) assert_equal(saved[1], 0) assert_equal(saved[2], 0) } else { '+check.call('saved','i')+' }' : ''} i += 1 }\nlet final := snapshot() #{check.call('final',calls)} assert_equal(len(final), #{width}) mut k := 0 while k < #{width} { assert_equal(original[k], 0) if k >= 3 { assert_equal(final[k], 0) } k += 1 } print(\"SCALAR FIRST PASS\")\n"
  File.write(d+'/owner.kujo',owner);File.write(d+'/main.kujo',source);[d+'/owner.kujo',d+'/main.kujo'].each{|p|r[:sources][p]=sha.call(p)}
  meta={shape:shape,width:width,snapshot:snapshot,calls:calls,path:d+'/main.kujo'}
  %w[vm jit].each do |mode|
   args=[probe,mode,meta[:path]];stdout,stderr,status=Open3.capture3(*args);m=stderr.match(/requests=(\d+) requested_bytes=(\d+)/)
   raise stdout+stderr unless status.success?&&stdout=="SCALAR FIRST PASS\n"&&m
   r[:rows]<<meta.merge(mode:mode,argv:args,stdout:stdout,stderr:stderr,exit:status.exitstatus,requests:m[1].to_i,bytes:m[2].to_i);save.call
  end
  %w[vm interpreter jit].each do |mode|
   args=[bin,'run',meta[:path],'--untrusted','--scheduler-no-timeout']+(mode=='vm' ? [] : ['--'+mode]);stdout,stderr,status=Open3.capture3(*args)
   raise stdout+stderr unless status.success?&&stdout=="SCALAR FIRST PASS\n"
   r[:semantics]<<meta.merge(mode:mode,argv:args,stdout:stdout,stderr:stderr,exit:status.exitstatus);save.call
  end
 end
 raise 'Coverage' unless r[:rows].size==96&&r[:semantics].size==144
 r[:slopes]=r[:rows].group_by{|x|x.values_at(:shape,:width,:snapshot,:mode)}.map{|key,rows|a,b=rows.sort_by{|x|x[:calls]}.last(2);{group:key,bytes:(b[:bytes]-a[:bytes])/16.0,requests:(b[:requests]-a[:requests])/16.0}}
 r[:identities].merge(r[:sources]).each{|p,h|raise 'Drift' unless sha.call(p)==h};r[:status]='characterized';save.call
rescue=>e;r[:status]='failed';r[:error]=e.message;save.call;raise
end
